mapper.select: SELECT e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID AS execution_id, i.JOB_NAME AS job_name, (SELECT p.PARAMETER_VALUE FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS p WHERE p.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID AND p.PARAMETER_NAME = 'targetDate') AS target_date, (SELECT p.PARAMETER_VALUE FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS p WHERE p.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID AND p.PARAMETER_NAME = 'requestedBy') AS requested_by, e.START_TIME AS start_time, e.END_TIME AS end_time, e.STATUS AS status, e.EXIT_CODE AS exit_code, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.READ_COUNT), 0) FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION s WHERE s.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID) AS read_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.WRITE_COUNT), 0) FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION s WHERE s.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID) AS write_count FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION e INNER JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE i ON i.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = e.JOB_INSTANCE_ID ORDER BY e.JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
